verdict.rationale: Spline is a design tool, so a developer inspect or handoff mode is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never documents per-layer inspection of measurements, styles or assets, CSS/iOS/Android snippets, or access without an editor seat. Whole-scene code export (Vanilla JS, Three.js, React and similar) and self-hosted ZIP export are a different, adjacent capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect any layer and get measurements, styles, assets, and code snippets (CSS/iOS/Android) without an editor seat
